messages:
emma-partnerships: Quick sync — thinking about a small accelerator for marketplace private offers to kickstart committed spend with HW partners. idea: short-term enhanced discount + co-announcement window if customer signs a 12mo commit. thoughts? :thinking_face:
ryan-sales: I like it. can we keep tiers simple? e.g., 100k => 10% off, 250k => 17% off, 500k+ => 22% off. include a 90-day signup window for the accel?
sarah-pm: If we do co-announcement, marketing needs 3 weeks lead time and approval on messaging. also prefer limited number of initial partners (2-3) to avoid ops complexity.
oliver-finance: Need margin floor check — discounts above 20% start impacting recognition assumptions for Reserved Revenue. Ask: are these discounts stackable with hardware rebates? we should cap effective discount at ~25%.
li-legal: Two quick legal flags: 1) private offer language has to preserve audit rights for marketplace usage; 2) co-announcement requires partner mutual approval clause and a standard quote of logos + timing. also a renewal mechanism — auto-renew at market rates unless customer opts into a renewal discount within 30 days of term end.
emma-partnerships: Good flags. On hardware stacking: proposal is to allow partner hardware credits to be additive but count only up to 10% of the commit for Redwood discount calculation. keeps our net exposure predictable.
ryan-sales: Operational question — will marketplace SKUs be metered (per-token/per-embed) or flat committed SKU? customers we target want predictable spend, so flat committed SKU with true-ups seems cleaner. We can expose a metered SKU for overages.
sarah-pm: Agreed on committed SKU + overage metering. For co-announcement cadence: pilot customers need to have PR release windows cleared; recommend a 60-day window from contract signature to announcement to allow integration testing.
marketplace-bot: Note: AWS Marketplace private offers require partner to set a private offer expiration and policy notes. ensure contract references Marketplace PO ID.
oliver-finance: I'll run a quick pro-forma for the three tiers with assumed gross margin and ARR uplift. need typical uplift percent on renewals — what should we model?
ryan-sales: Historically, committed customers convert to renew at ~85% and spend increases +12% on renewal if we offer a moderate renewal credit. For this accel, model conservative +8% uplift and 80% renewal rate.
li-legal: For renewal credits, keep them time-limited and tied to signature of renewal within a 45-day window. Also include a clause for usage audit frequency (annual) and overage reconciliation terms.
emma-partnerships: Action items: 1) oliver — pro-forma by EOD Wed; 2) li — draft private offer & co-announcement clause template; 3) sarah — marketing timeline and partner list by Mon; 4) ryan — sales playbook + target list. I'll coordinate with HW partners on credit stacking limits. :white_check_mark:
ryan-sales: I'll start building the playbook. can someone put the discount table in shared drive?
sarah-pm: I'll drop a quick matrix in the partnerships drive after lunch.
marketplace-bot: Reminder: create private offer in marketplace test env and validate SKU mapping before sending to partner.
emma-partnerships: Thanks — let's reconvene in 4 days to review drafts. if anyone needs to be looped in (legal ops, partner-marketing), ping me directly. :v:
